# sophosfirewall_service (Data Source)

Looks up an existing service by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Built-in services cannot be managed, but can be looked up.
data "sophosfirewall_service" "https" {
  name = "HTTPS"
}

output "https_ports" {
  value = data.sophosfirewall_service.https.tcp_udp[*].destination_port
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the service.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Free-text description.
- `icmp` (Attributes List) ICMPv4 type/code entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icmp))
- `icmpv6` (Attributes List) ICMPv6 type/code entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--icmpv6))
- `id` (String) UUID of the object assigned by the firewall.
- `ip_protocols` (Set of String) IP protocols (at most 100), using the API keywords, e.g. `gre`, `esp`, `ah`, `sctp`, `ospfigp` or `ipProto99` for unnamed protocol numbers.
- `tcp_udp` (Attributes List) TCP/UDP port entries (at most 100). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tcp_udp))

<a id="nestedatt--tcp_udp"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tcp_udp`

Read-Only:

- `destination_port` (String) Destination port, either a single port such as `443` or a range `from:to` such as `1024:65535`. Defaults to `1:65535` (any port).
- `protocol` (String) Transport protocol. One of `tcp`, `udp`.
- `source_port` (String) Source port, either a single port such as `443` or a range `from:to` such as `1024:65535`. Defaults to `1:65535` (any port).
